theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fc_ims_ae_limit_imrep
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : ℕ → IMRep U n) (η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), IsOpen U → (∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], Tendsto (fun q => (R q).carrier.indicator (fun y => ((R q).mult y : ℝ) • (R q).orient y) x) atTop (𝓝 (η x))) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ≥0∞, C ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ q, (R q).measure K ≤ C) → ∃ R' : IMRep U n, (∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], R'.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R'.mult y : ℝ) • R'.orient y) x = η x) ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, R'.action ω = ∫ x, η x (ω x) ∂μHE[n]
